subject: Money
title: The Latte Factor Debate
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Latte Factor Debate.

hook.text: David Bach said skip the $5 latte and invest it. Over 30 years, that's $330,000. Simple, right?

buildup.text: The latte factor says small daily expenses compound into life-changing money over decades.

discovery.text: Critics argue the real problem is stagnant wages and housing costs, not coffee. The math is right; the framing is wrong.

twist.text: Both sides are partially right. Small leaks matter AND systemic costs matter. It's not either/or.

climax.text: The latte isn't the problem. Mindless spending is. Keep the latte if it's intentional; cut it if it's not.

punchline.text: Drink the latte. Just know the price.

quiz.question: What is the 'latte factor' concept about?
options: How small daily expenses compound over time
